digest.component_or_area: live Jira Data Center harness test / provenance oracle
propositions: the provenance test's substring scan for remote_key (RAW Jira key) in json.dumps(ticket) cannot match because the local id is lowercased by _jira_key_to_local_id and the raw key does not appear in the ticket payload

the ticket payload carries the Jira key only as a title fallback when summary is absent, not as a field that list_tickets returns, so the binding between local id and remote key is recorded only in the binding store
the test must assert exact id equality derived from _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and additionally assert the binding store maps that local id to remote_key to prove the round-trip

the oracle defect is the third instance of a live test authored against assumed output shape rather than the shape the code actually emits, rendering the test unable to distinguish a correctly-created ticket from a missing one
